1939-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3480-4289-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

985-4742-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7933.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cold-Blooded Crew trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2415-7839.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
2415-7839.notes: You can use any self-sacrificing artifact, such as Food or Clue tokens, in place of the Treasure to start. Depending on the token used, you may need additional mana or other pre-requisites.

2034-4460-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

215-4188-4460.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-4460.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2204-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2103-7068-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Baboon Spirit.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

671-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-2033-6321-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-6321-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

640-1833-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-1833-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Stormbound Geist.
Stormbound Geist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Stormbound Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Stormbound Geist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

1170-1328-2105-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-7296.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1115-1171-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-2907-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4316-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
4316-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

645-2060-2921-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-2921-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1021-2034-5414-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-2034-5414-6761.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-2034-5414-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

372-695-1018.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-1018.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2440-2816-5917.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to The Jolly Balloon Man.
2440-2816-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2440-2816-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2440-2816-5917.notes: Less mana is needed if you control creatures that share a creature type with the creature you are copying.

539-2034-3585-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Greensleeves, Maro-Sorcerer triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

2556-4050-4053-4323.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base toughness two or greater.
2556-4050-4053-4323.description:
Cast Cauldron Haze by paying {1}{W/B}, giving Archaeoamncer and at least one additional creature with base toughness two or greater persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall and the additional creature, adding  {1}{W/B}.
When the creatures die, their persisit abilities trigger, returning themselves from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero -1/-1 counters due to Solemnity.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cauldron Haze to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If you control an additional nontoken creature with base toughness two or greater, you may also sacrifice and return it to get infinite colored mana.

2034-2450-2554-5195.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Third Path Iconoclast and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Third Path Iconoclast trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

868-1368-2056-3698.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
868-1368-2056-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Desperate Ritual from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1913-2558-2899-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1913-2558-2899-4659.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1 creature due to Kaervek.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature.
Imotekh triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens that enter the battlefield as 1/1 creatures due to Kaervek.
Repeat from step 2.

2201-4727.description:
Godhead of Awe causes all other creatures to have base power and toughness of 1/1.
Crovax gives all nonwhite creatures -1/-1.
Any nonwhite creatures will enter the battlefield as a 0/0 creature, and will die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.

1734-3913-4050.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding one mana of any color.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.
Crypt Champion enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Crypt Champion trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

262-2440-4038.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
262-2440-4038.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
The Elemental tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
